hebrewText: הַֽ֭/יְחָבְרְ/ךָ כִּסֵּ֣א הַוּ֑וֹת יֹצֵ֖ר עָמָ֣ל עֲלֵי חֹֽק

tokens.bdb: to join (literally or figuratively); specifically (by means of spells) to fascinate
tokens.kjv: charm(-er), be compact, couple (together), have fellowship with, heap up, join (self, together), league.

tokens.bdb: properly, covered, i.e. a throne (as canopied)
by implication, of falling); desire; also ruin
tokens.kjv: calamity, iniquity, mischief, mischievous (thing), naughtiness, naughty, noisome, perverse thing, substance, very wickedness.

tokens.bdb: to mould into a form; especially as apotter; figuratively, to determine (i.e. form a resolution)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] earthen, fashion, form, frame, make(-r), potter, purpose.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to mould into a form; especially as apotter; figuratively
tokens.enLiteralWord: to mould into a form; especially as apotter; figuratively
tokens.explanation: to mould into a form; especially as apotter; figuratively
tokens.explanationEn: to mould into a form; especially as apotter; figuratively

tokens.bdb: toil, i.e. wearing effort; hence, worry, wheth. of body or mind
tokens.kjv: grievance(-vousness), iniquity, labour, mischief, miserable(-sery), pain(-ful), perverseness, sorrow, toil, travail, trouble, wearisome, wickedness.

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage)
tokens.kjv: appointed, bound, commandment, convenient, custom, decree(-d), due, law, measure, [idiom] necessary, ordinance(-nary), portion, set time, statute, task.
